# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-docs.sh from `corral <cmd> --help`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Generated from `corral 0.1.0`. Every command also accepts
`--root <ROOT>` (the directory containing `.corral/`; default: discovered from the current directory).

```text
Project management control plane for agentic coding, inside herdr

Usage: corral [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  init        Create .corral/ in --root or the current directory
  stats       Outcome evidence grouped by profile (default), model, task kind or project
  new         Create a task and print its id
  list        List tasks (done/dropped hidden unless --all; --done lists finished tasks, newest first)
  show        Show one task
  move        Move a task to another status
  edit        Open the task file in $EDITOR
  route       Explain which profile would run a task without starting it
  dispatch    Start an agent run for a task
  reply       Send a reply to the task's agent
  unstick     Terminate a stuck foreign foreground process after confirmation, then retry the pending reply
  done        Mark the run finished and move the task to Review
  gate        Run the review gate commands in the current run's worktree (in a herdr pane)
  review-run  Start an independent review of the current run (a reviewer profile in its own pane, or the PM)
  verdict     Record a review verdict on the current run
  artifact    Manage artifacts
  pin         Pin a task (T-042) or artifact (T-042:R1:<file>) so it is one step away
  unpin       Remove a pin (by ref or pin number)
  pins        List pins in order
  open        Open a pin (number or ref) or any task/artifact ref with its viewer: [viewers], else $CORRAL_OPENER, else terminal-browser for HTML inside herdr, else the system opener (WSL-aware)
  review      Show the review summary of a task
  approve     Merge the run and mark the task Done
  changes     Request changes on a task in Review
  retry       Start a fresh run for a task
  discard     Discard the current run and drop the task
  jump        Focus the task's herdr pane
  sync        Reconcile tasks with herdr and advance the review autopilot (--watch: keep syncing every 2 s, headless)
  autopilot   Turn the review autopilot on or off, or show it and the tasks it is driving
  hook        herdr plugin event hook: run sync once, always exit 0
  pm          Open or focus the PM pane
  board       Open the board TUI
  capture     Open the capture popup
  artifacts   Open the artifact finder
  settings    Open the settings screen
  harness     Installed agent harnesses, their versions and models
  plugin      Manage the herdr plugin
  skill       Print the corral agent skill (SKILL.md), or install it for your agents
  config      Read, change and check .corral/corral.toml
  help        Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
  -V, --version      Print version
```

## `corral init`

```text
Create .corral/ in --root or the current directory

Usage: corral init [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
```

## `corral stats`

```text
Outcome evidence grouped by profile (default), model, task kind or project

Usage: corral stats [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --by <BY>        [default: profile] [possible values: profile, model, kind, project]
      --root <ROOT>    Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --since <SINCE>  Include runs dispatched in the last N days, hours or weeks (e.g. 30d)
      --json           
  -h, --help           Print help
```

## `corral new`

```text
Create a task and print its id

Usage: corral new [OPTIONS] <TITLE>...

Arguments:
  <TITLE>...  

Options:
  -p, --project <PROJECT>      
      --root <ROOT>            Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --idea                   
      --ready                  
      --body <BODY>            
      --body-file <BODY_FILE>  
      --profile <PROFILE>      Preferred profile for dispatch [alias: --agent]
      --depends <DEPENDS>      
      --priority <PRIORITY>    
      --kind <KIND>            Task category used by routing rules
      --size <SIZE>            Estimated task size used by routing rules
  -h, --help                   Print help
```

## `corral list`

```text
List tasks (done/dropped hidden unless --all; --done lists finished tasks, newest first)

Usage: corral list [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --root <ROOT>        Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --status <STATUS>    
      --project <PROJECT>  
      --all                
      --done               Only Done tasks, newest finished first, with finish date and the sha their approval landed
      --since <SINCE>      With --done: only tasks finished in the last N hours, days or weeks (e.g. 7d)
      --json               
  -h, --help               Print help
```

## `corral route`

```text
Explain which profile would run a task without starting it

Usage: corral route [OPTIONS] <ID>

Arguments:
  <ID>  

Options:
      --profile <PROFILE>  Profile (harness + model + effort preset) for this run [alias: --agent]
      --root <ROOT>        Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --model <MODEL>      Model override for this run
      --effort <EFFORT>    Effort level override for this run (valid levels depend on the harness)
      --json               
  -h, --help               Print help
```

## `corral dispatch`


## `corral skill`

```text
Print the corral agent skill (SKILL.md), or install it for your agents

Usage: corral skill [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  install  Write corral/SKILL.md into agent skill dirs (default: every harness found in $HOME)
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
```

### `corral skill install`

```text
Write corral/SKILL.md into agent skill dirs (default: every harness found in $HOME)

Usage: corral skill install [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --harness <HARNESS>  Harness to install for; repeatable [possible values: omo, omp, claude, agents]
      --root <ROOT>        Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --dir <DIR>          Install into this skills directory instead
      --force              Replace a SKILL.md that corral did not write
  -h, --help               Print help
```

## `corral config`

```text
Read, change and check .corral/corral.toml

Usage: corral config [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  get       Print a setting by dotted key (e.g. limits.running, projects.app.path); defaults included
  set       Change a setting in place, keeping comments; refused when the result would be invalid
  validate  Check corral.toml and list every problem (exits non-zero when invalid)
  path      Print the path of corral.toml
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
```

### `corral config get`

```text
Print a setting by dotted key (e.g. limits.running, projects.app.path); defaults included

Usage: corral config get [OPTIONS] <KEY>

Arguments:
  <KEY>  

Options:
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
```

### `corral config set`

```text
Change a setting in place, keeping comments; refused when the result would be invalid

Usage: corral config set [OPTIONS] <KEY> <VALUE>

Arguments:
  <KEY>    
  <VALUE>  TOML value (3, true, ["a", "b"], "quoted"); anything else is taken as a string

Options:
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
```

### `corral config validate`

```text
Check corral.toml and list every problem (exits non-zero when invalid)

Usage: corral config validate [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
```

### `corral config path`

```text
Print the path of corral.toml

Usage: corral config path [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
```
